_source.title: 判断点是否在多边形内部
_source.remarks.text.0: 使用射线法（Ray Casting）判断点是否在多边形内部
_source.remarks.text.1:
由于射线法的特性，边界上的点行为不一致：部分边界上的点可能返回 `true`，部分可能返回 `false`，
具体取决于射线方向与边界的几何关系
_source.remarks.text.2: 如需严格判断点是否在边界上，请结合 {@link SYS_Math.distanceToPoint} 判断距离是否为 `0`

title: Determine whether the point is inside the polygon
remarks.text.0: Use the ray casting method to determine whether the point is inside the polygon
remarks.text.1:
Due to the characteristics of the ray casting method, points on the boundary behave inconsistently: some boundary points may return `true`, and some may return `false`,
depending on the geometric relationship between the ray direction and the boundary
remarks.text.2: To strictly determine whether the point is on the boundary, combine {@link SYS_Math.distanceToPoint} to check whether the distance is `0`
